question: Which initiative has the Reserve Bank of India launched to address climate change risks and sustainable finance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**On Tap Cohort.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is launching a dedicated 'On Tap' cohort on climate change risks and sustainable finance.**
 
• **This initiative will be part of RBI’s Regulatory Sandbox to encourage financial innovations in green finance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'On Tap' cohort aims to support capacity building, ecosystem development, and financing for sustainable projects.
 
• RBI is also planning to conduct a special ‘Greenathon’ focused on climate change and related aspects.
 
• Green finance projects face higher credit risks due to the use of emerging green technologies with limited operational track records.
 
• Priority sector lending in India already supports credit flow to renewable energy and sustainable projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Regulatory Sandbox__

 __
 
• An initiative by RBI to allow fintech startups and financial institutions to test innovative financial solutions under regulatory supervision.
 
• Encourages development in digital payments, lending, and sustainable finance.
 
 
 
• Green Finance Challenges__
 __
 
• Higher credit risk due to new technologies with limited performance history.
 
• Need for technical know-how among financial institutions for risk assessment in green projects.
 
 
 
• Climate Change Risks in Finance__
 __
 
• Impacts financial risks including credit risk, market risk, and operational risk.
 
• Requires coordination among regulators, financial institutions, and government agencies.
 
 
 
• RBI's Role in Sustainable Finance__
 
 
• Facilitates policy and regulatory support for green finance initiatives.
 
• Aims to create a stable financial system resilient to climate-related risks.
